## PROBLEM
Production PR2 diff must not ship untracked TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX/TEMP/WIP/NOTE(release) obligations.
## SUCCESS
Return CLEAN or cite every new unstructured production marker.
## SCOPE
Executor diff for xtrm-56flm.2.
## NON_GOALS
No edits and no blocking on test/doc markers.
## CONSTRAINTS
READ_ONLY; structured markers require a live bead; SCRUTINY: high.
## VALIDATION
Scan cumulative diff against origin/main.
## OUTPUT
Machine-readable CLEAN / OBLIGATIONS_FOUND / BLOCKED verdict.
